referenceUse: Previous individual portraits were edited, using the final central-bank portrait as a style reference for the remaining seven. Reference portraits are project-generated fictional characters.

prompts.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: one transparent adviser avatar for the Japanese browser game MACRO NATION.
Make the target much more KAWAII JAPANESE ANIME in the style of a polished animated-series chibi character model sheet. Strong cute anime stylization, airy cheerful colors and a sweet approachable appearance.
Art direction: 2D hand-drawn anime cel illustration, smooth clean slightly colored contours, very large sparkling rounded anime eyes with simple iris gradients and clear white highlights, tiny simplified curved-stroke nose, very small soft smile with NO realistic lips and NO lipstick, soft round cheeks with small blush marks, rounded face and small chin. Cute stylized adult adviser, about 2.5-head chibi proportions; large head, short neck and small shoulders. Retain character-specific adult identity cues such as gray hair and glasses but simplify facial detail dramatically.
Hair: simple clean anime locks and broad cel highlights, minimal lines, no detailed strands or realistic texture. Outfit: bright clear cel colors, simple folds, rounded shape language. Skin: flat soft peach cel color and very gentle shading. Warm, playful anime character appeal. No photographic detail, no glossy realistic lips, no fashion-beauty realism, no dense dark-brown painted textures.
One character, square centered head and upper chest, full hairstyle and shoulders inside the frame, large readable face and role-defining clothing. Keep all eight adviser portraits coherent in outline weight, eye design, cute proportions and cel shading.
Preserve recognizable hairstyle and hair color, glasses or earrings, role-specific jacket/tie/scarf, and assigned color family. Preserve each personality through eyebrows and mouth.
Genuine transparent alpha background. No background scene, frame, circle, lettering, labels, logos, watermark, hands, props or floating symbols.
Edit target: 水城 静香, central bank expert. Keep her neat black bob, silver stud earrings, navy-blue jacket and ivory blouse. Calm, intelligent and kind, with a tiny reassuring smile and soft slightly raised eyebrows. Cute sparkly brown anime eyes. Transform the earlier pop-chibi rendering further toward clean kawaii anime: very small anime mouth, simple nose, lighter softer linework and flatter clearer cel shading.
